issues.legal_issue: Rights subject to extinction during the constitution of a private protected forest are extinguished only after publication of the final notification.
material_facts: A notification declared the intention to constitute the forest a private protected forest, and a later notification under the proviso to section 30 was issued while the statutory inquiries and procedures remained incomplete.
No final notification under the main part of section 30 had been published.
The State contended that the provisional notification extinguished rights for which no claim had been made or which had not been discovered by inquiry.
issues.conclusion: Rights within section 19 could be extinguished only after publication of the final notification under section 30, not upon publication of the provisional notification under its proviso.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 14–19 and 30 of the Bihar Private Forests Act, the process for making claims, investigating rights, and dealing with appeals precedes the final constitution of a private protected forest. Read in that statutory context, section 19 extinguishes the specified unclaimed and undiscovered rights only after the final section 30 notification; the provisional notification operates pending completion of those procedures. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: private_forest_rights_proceeding and right_is_unclaimed_and_unknown and provisional_notification_published and not final_notification_published

predicates.private_forest_rights_proceeding: The proceeding concerns the treatment of rights during the statutory process for constituting a private forest as a protected forest.
predicates.right_is_unclaimed_and_unknown: The right-holder did not claim the right within the prescribed process, and the right was not discovered through the relevant inquiry.
predicates.provisional_notification_published: The government published a provisional notification while the statutory inquiries, procedures, or appeals were pending.
predicates.final_notification_published: The government published the final notification constituting the forest as a private protected forest.
predicates.covered_rights_remain_unextinguished: The covered rights have not yet been extinguished.

issues.definition: When a right falls within the category of unclaimed and undiscovered rights in a private-forest proceeding, a provisional notification does not extinguish it before the final notification is published.

issues.legal_issue: Rules governing the cutting or removal of trees while a forest remains a forest do not control cutting necessary to clear protected forest land for cultivation when the prescribed written permission for clearance has been given.
material_facts: The land formed part of a protected forest, and clearing it for cultivation required cutting and removing trees.
The Collector gave written permission for reclamation and cultivation.
The Forest Officer relied on rules restricting the cutting or removal of trees and stopped the reclamation.
issues.conclusion: Rules 1 to 4 did not govern the cutting necessary to clear the land for cultivation; the Collector's permission under rule 8 was lawful, and the Forest Officer had no authority under those rules to interfere with the permitted clearance.
issues.legal_principle: Section 32 of the Indian Forest Act distinguishes rule-making about cutting and removal of forest produce from rule-making about clearing or breaking land for cultivation. Bihar Protected Forest Rules 1 to 4, made under section 32(a)–(d), regulate cutting or removal where the forest remains a forest; rule 8, made under section 32(g), governs clearance or breaking of land for cultivation or another purpose. The provisions must be read harmoniously. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: protected_forest_clearance_dispute and clearance_requires_tree_cutting and written_clearance_permission_given and cutting_rules_preserve_forest

predicates.protected_forest_clearance_dispute: The dispute concerns clearing or breaking protected forest land for cultivation or another purpose.
predicates.clearance_requires_tree_cutting: The proposed clearance requires cutting or removing trees.
predicates.written_clearance_permission_given: The Collector gave written permission for the land to be cleared or broken up.
predicates.cutting_rules_preserve_forest: The rules invoked to restrict tree cutting regulate cutting that leaves the land a forest.
predicates.tree_cutting_rules_do_not_override_clear: The rules restricting tree cutting do not invalidate the permission to clear the land.

issues.definition: Where protected forest land is to be cleared with written permission and the cutting restrictions concern cutting that leaves the forest intact, those restrictions do not override the clearance permission.

issues.legal_issue: A general prohibition on clearing protected forest land does not invalidate clearance carried out in accordance with rules made for that purpose.
material_facts: The government issued a notification prohibiting the breaking up or clearing of protected forest land for cultivation.
The Collector had given written permission under rule 8 for reclamation and cultivation.
Section 34 addressed acts done in accordance with rules made under section 32.
issues.conclusion: The notification's prohibition did not prevent clearance carried out in accordance with rule 8, and the government and Forest Officer had no legal authority to interfere with that permitted clearance.
issues.legal_principle: Section 30 of the Indian Forest Act empowers the government to prohibit specified acts in a protected forest, while section 32(g) permits rules regulating clearance and breaking of land for cultivation or another purpose. Section 34 provides that the chapter does not prohibit acts done in accordance with rules made under section 32. Accordingly, a prohibition under section 30 is ineffective against clearance permitted in accordance with rule 8 of the Bihar Protected Forest Rules. No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.protected_forest_clearance_dispute: The dispute concerns clearing or breaking protected forest land for cultivation or another purpose.
predicates.prohibitory_notification_published: The government published a notification prohibiting the relevant kind of clearance in the protected forest.
predicates.clearance_complies_with_applicable_rule: The proposed clearance is carried out in accordance with a rule governing clearance of protected forest land.
predicates.prohibition_does_not_bar_permitted_clear: The general prohibition does not bar the clearance permitted by the applicable rule.

issues.definition: When protected forest clearance complies with an applicable rule, a general notification prohibiting that clearance does not prevent it.
